text:
eli: quick heads-up: after flipping grace_window=500ms for SSE resume in the routing canary, we saw lots of 1s-lived sessions and a correlated spike in reconnect attempts. console shows route errors but session_duration p50 jumped in a weird way.

maya: which canary and what time?

eli: canary id gc-1891010000 rolled at 14:10. spikes start 14:12. example log: 

```
14:12:03 conn=tn42 route=us-west tenant=beta-team event=connected
14:12:03 conn=tn42 event=close reason=grace-window-expire
14:12:03 conn=tn42 reconnect backoff=0.1s sampled=false
```

eli: notice sampled=false so console stream panels didn't capture the short session churn.

jordan: we lowered grace_window to reduce tail-latency for hot connections; side-effect is some mobile clients do a rapid re-open and get caught in the proto dance. sampling hides this.

ops-bot: deploy 1891010000 applied to service/routing-canary by ci-cd at 14:10:04

maya: two quick mitigations: (1) temporarily bump sampling for requests with header `x-canary=gc-1891010000` to 100% for 10m, (2) emit a low-cardinality `session.probe=1` at connect and close (telemetry_only).

eli: also a client-side suggestion: sdk should randomize reconnect jitter for first 500ms to spread retries. we'll open a tiny release.

jordan: for the CB/grace interplay, i propose increasing grace_window to 1s for canaries where client platform=mobile (we can inspect `x-client-platform`). reduces tight loops for flaky networks.

console-team: for dashboards: add `sum(session.probe)` and overlay sample_fraction. expose a toggle to "Show rollout probes" that reveals `rollout_id` tag only when present. show warning pill when sample_fraction < 0.05.

maya: implementation sketch in proxy: 

```
if req.headers['x-canary'] == 'gc-1891010000':
  metrics.sampling.rate = 1.0
  metrics.emit('session.probe', {telemetry_only: 'true', rollout_id: 'gc-1891010000'})
else if session.close:
  metrics.emit('session.probe', {telemetry_only: 'true'})
```

maya: ensure `rollout_id` added only when header present to avoid cardinality explosion. mark probe events non-billable.

eli: runbook short rule: if reconnect_rate > 150/min and probe_count < 40 in 5m for canary -> auto-pause and rollback. otherwise keep canary and keep sampling override for 30m.

jordan: add a lightweight ephemeral log flag `X-Debug-Sample: 1` that we can enable for a tenant to get un-sampled traces for 10m if we need deeper debugging. ops-bot can toggle it.

ops-bot: incident INC-2422 created: "grace_window canary: short-lived sessions hidden by sampling" assigned to @eli priority=P2

maya: small telemetry improvement: emit `session.intent=resume` boolean when a reconnect path intends to rejoin session state; that allows console to reconcile expected resume vs new session semantics without extra identifiers. boolean only.

eli: thanks. i'll open PRs: proxy sampling override + probe -> https://git.internal/r/proxy/+/3001, sdk jitter -> https://git.internal/r/sdk/+/3002, rollout controller pause rule -> https://git.internal/r/rollouts/+/3003. will update when merged.

console-team: we'll add the probe panel and sample fraction indicator. also wire the rollout toggle to show `rollout_id` tag only when enabled.

jordan: timeline: sampling override now (hotfix), sdk jitter in next 2h, rollout pause rule in next deploy window.

eli: leaving thread for async updates. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
